_meta.purpose: Curated local TV-station and newspaper RSS feeds used by the Local News/ Across Your State source picker. Bundled because no free location-aware news API gave us reliable hyperlocal coverage; see commit history for the rabbit hole.

<state-abbrev>._state: { coords: { lat, lon }, entries: [ statewide entries ] } — coords are the state's geographic center (or capital); used to suggest this state as a fallback when no nearby city is in the repo
<state-abbrev>.<lowercase-city>: { coords: { lat, lon }, entries: [ entries serving that city ] } — coords are the city's centroid; used to compute nearest-city fallbacks

entry.name: Display label shown in the picker (include city + outlet)
entry.rss: Direct RSS feed URL (validate it returns content before adding!)
entry.site: Public-facing landing page (used for the favicon and click-through)

schema.legacyShape: An older form where a city's value was just an array of entries (no coords) is still tolerated by getStationsForGeo for backward compat — but new entries MUST include coords so they participate in the nearest-city fallback.
schema.subreddits: Array of subreddit names (without 'r/') curated as news-relevant community feeds. Personals / dating / NSFW subs excluded by editorial choice. The picker constructs https://www.reddit.com/r/<name>/.rss for each — verify with the worker proxy before adding.

howToAdd: 1. Find a candidate RSS URL for the local outlet (TV station, paper, etc.).
2. Verify it returns items via the proxy: curl -s 'https://happening-now.net/v1/rss/raw?url=<urlencoded>' | grep -c '<item'  -- if 0, skip.
3. Add an entry under states.<XX>.<lowercase-city>.entries for hyperlocal, or states.<XX>._state.entries for statewide.

4. When adding a NEW city or state block, include coords: { lat, lon } at the city/state level (decimal degrees, ~4 sig figs). City coords = city centroid; statewide coords = capital or geographic center. Without coords, the city won't appear in nearest-city fallback suggestions.
5. Keep entries sorted alphabetically within each entries array.
6. Lookups are case-insensitive: getStationsForGeo({ city:'Jackson', state:'MI' }) finds states.MI.jackson.
7. Subreddits: add a `subreddits: ["name1", "name2"]` array alongside `entries`. Verify each via /r/<name>/.rss returns ≥1 entry through the proxy before committing.
